## Tutorials

The Cos() function returns the cosine of an angle.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Cos(5) AS CosNum;

---

number
```

## Tutorials

The Count() function returns the number of records returned by a select query.

Note:NULL values are not counted.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Count(ProductID) AS NumberOfProducts FROM Products;

---

Count(
expression
)
```

## Tutorials

The Fix() function returns the integer part of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Fix(756.43) AS FixNum;

---

Fix(
number
)

---

SELECT Fix(Price) AS FixNum FROM Products;
```

## Tutorials

The Format() function formats a numeric value with the specified format.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Format(0.5, "Percent") AS FormattedNum;

---

Format(
value
,
format
)

---

SELECT Format(Price, "Currency") AS FormattedPrice
FROM Products;
```
